name: Cable Lugs
summary: Tin electroplated ETP copper cable lugs in eight series: standard and long barrel, one and two hole.
intro: Copper lugs manufactured from ETP copper with a tin electroplated finish. An inspection hole and a bell mouth (flared) entry are available on request.

The default configuration of any lug is without inspection window and without flared or bell mouth entry. Add "I" after the product code for an inspection hole and "B" for a bell mouth or flared entry.
features: Bell mouth entry available on request
